title: ذخیره عکس و ضمیمه روی هارد (نه حافظه مرورگر)
changelog: عکس پس‌زمینه، لوگو و اسناد ضمیمه دیگر در localStorage ذخیره نمی‌شوند
ذخیره روی هارد در پوشه بک‌آپ زیر sirman_media
بدون انتخاب پوشه بک‌آپ، افزودن عکس/ضمیمه مسدود است تا حافظه مرورگر پر نشود
مهاجرت خودکار dataURLهای قدیمی به دیسک پس از انتخاب پوشه

:root{

*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
body{font-family:var(--font);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-size:13px;}
/* SIDEBAR */
.sb{position:fixed;right:0;top:0;width:var(--sidebar);height:100vh;background:linear-gradient(185deg,var(--blue2) 0%,var(--skin-sidebar-end,#0A5F73) 100%);color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;z-index:100;overflow-y:auto;box-shadow:-6px 0 24px rgba(6,47,64,.18);}
.sb-logo{padding:14px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);text-align:center;cursor:pointer;}
.sb-logo img{max-width:130px;max-height:48px;object-fit:contain;}
.sb-brand{font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);margin-top:5px;line-height:1.5;}
.sb-nav{flex:1;padding:6px 0;}
.sb-section{font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);padding:10px 14px 4px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;}
.nav-it{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 14px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);transition:.15s;border-right:3px solid transparent;}
.nav-it:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff;}

.sb-foot{padding:10px 14px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);text-align:center;}

/* ══════ منوی کلاسیک + رفع بریدن متن سایدبار ══════ */
:root{--sidebar:268px;}
html,body{max-width:100%;}
.sb{
  position:fixed;right:0;top:0;
  width:var(--sidebar);
  height:100vh;height:100dvh;
  overflow-x:hidden;
  overflow-y:auto;
  overscroll-behavior:contain;
  transform:none!important; /* هرگز با perspective جابه‌جا نشود */
  will-change:auto;
  contain:layout paint;
  padding-right:max(10px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
  padding-left:6px;
  box-sizing:border-box;
}
.main{margin-right:var(--sidebar);max-width:calc(100% - var(--sidebar));}
@media (max-width:900px){
  :root{--sidebar:240px;}
}
.nav-it{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;
  padding:8px 10px 8px 8px; /* راست بیشتر تا آیکون نبرد */
  min-width:0;max-width:100%;
  white-space:normal;line-height:1.35;
  overflow:hidden;box-sizing:border-box;
  transform:none!important;
}
.nav-it .nav-ico{
  width:26px;height:26px;min-width:26px;min-height:26px;
  border-radius:6px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  flex-shrink:0;color:#fff;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35),0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.22),rgba(0,0,0,.18));
}
.nav-it .nav-ico svg{
  width:15px;height:15px;display:block;
  stroke:#fff;fill:none;
}
.nav-it .nav-txt{
  flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;
  overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-word;
  padding-top:3px;
}
.nav-it .nav-badge{flex-shrink:0;margin-right:0;margin-top:2px;}
.sb-section{
  gap:8px;padding:10px 12px 4px;min-width:0;
  white-space:normal;line-height:1.4;
}
.sb-section .sec-ico{
  width:18px;height:18px;min-width:18px;border-radius:4px;
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:11px;margin-left:6px;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25),0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
}
.sb-brand{overflow-wrap:anywhere;padding:0 4px;}
.gs-wrap{padding:0 8px;box-sizing:border-box;max-width:100%;}
.gs-input{width:100%;max-width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;}
#sb-clock{max-width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}
/* رنگ‌های کلاسیک هر آیتم (سبک نرم‌افزارهای قدیمی دسکتاپ) */
.nav-it[data-page="dashboard"] .nav-ico{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7dd3fc,#0284c7);}
.nav-it[data-page="tasks"] .nav-ico{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fcd34d,#d97706);}
.nav-it[data-page="invoice"] .nav-ico{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#93c5fd,#2563eb);}
.nav-it[data-page="saved"] .nav-ico{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#a5b4fc,#4f46e5);}

body.depth-3d .nav-it{margin:2px 4px;max-width:calc(100% - 8px);}
body.depth-3d .nav-it:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);}

/* ══════ ریل آیکون + پس‌زمینه‌های مجزا + شورتکات داشبورد ══════ */
/* عکس فقط داخل لایهٔ clipped (::before) — روی خود عنصر نیست تا از چارچوب بیرون نزند */
.sb, .main, #page-dashboard .dash-shell{
  background-size:cover!important;
  background-position:center center!important;
  background-repeat:no-repeat!important;
}
.sb.has-custom-bg{
  background-image:none!important;
  position:relative;
  isolation:isolate;
  overflow-x:hidden;
  contain:paint;
  background-clip:padding-box;
  clip-path:inset(0);
}
.sb.has-custom-bg::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
  background-image:var(--sb-bg-img);
  background-size:cover!important;
  background-position:center center!important;
  background-repeat:no-repeat!important;
  clip-path:inset(0);
}
.sb.has-custom-bg > *{position:relative;z-index:1;}
.main.has-custom-bg{
  background-image:none!important;
  background-color:transparent;
  position:relative;
  isolation:isolate;
  contain:paint;
  clip-path:inset(0);
}
.main.has-custom-bg::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
  background-image:var(--main-bg-img);
  background-size:cover!important;
  background-position:center center!important;
  background-repeat:no-repeat!important;
  clip-path:inset(0);
  min-height:100%;
}
.main.has-custom-bg > *{position:relative;z-index:1;}
#page-dashboard .dash-shell{
  min-height:calc(100vh - 0px);
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  border-radius:0;
  background:var(--dash-tint);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(11,79,108,.08);
  isolation:isolate;
  contain:paint;
  clip-path:inset(0);
}
#page-dashboard .dash-shell.has-dash-bg{
  background-image:none!important;
  background-color:transparent;
}
#page-dashboard .dash-shell.has-dash-bg::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
  background-image:var(--dash-bg-img);
  background-size:cover!important;
  background-position:center center!important;
  background-repeat:no-repeat!important;
  clip-path:inset(0);
}
body.theme-dark #page-dashboard .dash-shell:not(.has-dash-bg){
  background:var(--dash-tint, linear-gradient(165deg,#1a2833 0%,#1e2f3a 50%,#243028 100%));
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06);
}
#page-dashboard .dash-kpi{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);
  backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
}
body.theme-dark #page-dashboard .dash-kpi{
  background:rgba(30,36,44,.88);
}
#page-dashboard .dash-shell.has-dash-bg::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,var(--dash-bg-overlay,0.35));
  pointer-events:none;
}
body.theme-dark #page-dashboard .dash-shell.has-dash-bg::after{
  background:rgba(10,12,15,var(--dash-bg-overlay,0.45));
}
#page-dashboard .dash-shell > *{position:relative;z-index:1;}

/* شکل آیکون */
body.nav-shape-circle .nav-it .nav-ico{border-radius:50%!important;}
body.nav-shape-square .nav-it .nav-ico{border-radius:4px!important;}
body.nav-shape-rect .nav-it .nav-ico{border-radius:8px!important;width:34px;height:26px;min-width:34px;}
body.nav-shape-rounded .nav-it .nav-ico{border-radius:10px!important;}

/* حالت فقط‌شکل (ریل آیکون) — هیچ نوشتهٔ ثابتی دیده نمی‌شود */
body.sb-icons-only{--sidebar:78px;}
body.sb-icons-only .sb{
  width:78px;padding-right:4px;padding-left:4px;
  overflow:visible!important; /* تا برچسب کشویی بیرون نبرد */
  contain:none!important;
  z-index:400;
}
body.sb-icons-only .sb-nav{
  overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:visible;
  max-height:calc(100dvh - 70px);
  padding:4px 0 12px;
}
body.sb-icons-only .main{margin-right:78px;max-width:calc(100% - 78px);}
body.sb-icons-only .sb-brand,
body.sb-icons-only #sb-clock,
body.sb-icons-only .gs-wrap,
body.sb-icons-only .sb-section,
body.sb-icons-only .sb-foot,
body.sb-icons-only .nav-badge,
body.sb-icons-only .sb-group > .sb-section{display:none!important;}
body.sb-icons-only .sb-logo img{max-width:44px;max-height:34px;}
body.sb-icons-only .sb-logo{padding:10px 4px;border-bottom-color:rgba(255,255,255,.08);}
body.sb-icons-only .sb-group.collapsed .nav-it{display:flex!important;}
body.sb-icons-only .nav-it{
  justify-content:center;align-items:center;
  padding:10px 6px;margin:5px 2px;border-radius:12px;
  position:relative;overflow:visible;gap:0;
  border-right-color:transparent!important;
}
body.sb-icons-only .nav-it .nav-ico{
  width:46px;height:46px;min-width:46px;min-height:46px;
  border-radius:12px;flex-shrink:0;z-index:2;
}
body.sb-icons-only.nav-shape-circle .nav-it .nav-ico{border-radius:50%!important;}
body.sb-icons-only.nav-shape-square .nav-it .nav-ico{border-radius:4px!important;}
body.sb-icons-only.nav-shape-rect .nav-it .nav-ico{width:50px;height:36px;min-width:50px;border-radius:8px!important;}
body.sb-icons-only.nav-shape-rounded .nav-it .nav-ico{border-radius:12px!important;}
body.sb-icons-only .nav-it .nav-ico svg{width:22px;height:22px;}
body.sb-icons-only .nav-it.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);}
/* خاموش کردن تولتیپ سراسری روی آیتم منو — فقط کشویی */
body.sb-icons-only .nav-it[data-tip]:hover::after,
body.sb-icons-only .nav-it[data-tip]:hover::before,
body.sb-icons-only .nav-it:hover::after,
body.sb-icons-only .nav-it:hover::before{
  content:none!important;display:none!important;
}
/* برچسب کشویی: از راست (کنار آیکون) به چپ (داخل صفحه) */
body.sb-icons-only .nav-it .nav-txt{
  display:flex!important;
  align-items:center;
  position:absolute;
  top:50%;
  right:calc(100% + 2px); /* دقیقاً چپِ آیکون — سمت داخل صفحه */
  left:auto;
  transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(12px);
  transform-origin:right center;
  max-width:0;
  opacity:0;
  overflow:hidden;
  white-space:nowrap;
  pointer-events:none;
  background:#111827;
  color:#fff;
  padding:0;
  border-radius:10px 0 0 10px;
  font-size:12px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3;
  box-shadow:-6px 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
  z-index:500;
  transition:max-width .28s ease, opacity .22s ease, transform .28s ease, padding .28s ease;
}
body.sb-icons-only .nav-it:hover .nav-txt,
body.sb-icons-only .nav-it:focus-visible .nav-txt,
body.sb-icons-only .nav-it.slide-open .nav-txt{
  max-width:220px;
  opacity:1;
  padding:9px 14px 9px 16px;
  transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(0);
}
body.sb-icons-only .nav-it:hover,
body.sb-icons-only .nav-it.slide-open{z-index:510;}

/* شورتکات‌های داشبورد */
.dash-shortcuts{
  display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;min-height:110px;
  padding:14px;margin-bottom:14px;
  border:2px dashed color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 45%,var(--border));
  border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);
  align-content:flex-start;align-items:flex-start;
  transition:border-color .15s, background .15s;
}
body.theme-dark .dash-shortcuts{background:rgba(20,24,30,.45);}
.dash-shortcuts.drag-over{
  border-color:var(--blue);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue-l) 70%,transparent);
}
.dash-shortcuts-hint{
  width:100%;text-align:center;color:var(--text2);font-size:12px;padding:18px 8px;line-height:1.7;
}
.dash-sc{
  width:92px;min-height:92px;border-radius:14px;padding:10px 8px;
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(10,30,45,.08);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;
  cursor:pointer;position:relative;user-select:none;
  transition:box-shadow .12s, transform .12s;
}
.dash-sc:hover{box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(10,30,45,.14);}
.dash-sc .nav-ico, .dash-sc-ico{
  width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.3),0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#93c5fd,#2563eb); /* پیش‌فرض تا سفید نشود */
  flex-shrink:0;
}
.dash-sc .nav-ico svg, .dash-sc-ico svg{width:20px;height:20px;stroke:#fff!important;fill:none!important;color:#fff;}
/* همان پالت رنگی منو برای شورتکات‌ها (چون بیرون از .nav-it هستند) */
.dash-sc[data-page="dashboard"] .nav-ico,.dash-sc[data-page="dashboard"] .dash-sc-ico{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7dd3fc,#0284c7)!important;}

.dash-sc[data-page="warranty"] .nav-ico,.dash-sc[data-page="warranty"] .dash-sc-ico{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fda4af,#e11d48)!important;}
.dash-sc[data-page="dataio"] .nav-ico,.dash-sc[data-page="dataio"] .dash-sc-ico{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#94a3b8,#475569)!important;}
.dash-sc[data-page="datetime"] .nav-ico,.dash-sc[data-page="datetime"] .dash-sc-ico{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7dd3fc,#0369a1)!important;}

.dash-sc-lbl{font-size:11px;text-align:center;line-height:1.35;color:var(--text);max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}
.dash-sc-x{

}
.dash-sc-x:hover{background:var(--red);}
.dash-wallpaper-bar{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin:0 16px 10px;}

/* ══════ تم داک پایین — اصلاح نشت display:contents + داک جمع‌وجور ══════ */
/* در حالت عادی: contents تا ساختار منوی کامل خراب نشود */
.dock-flyout{display:contents;}
body.sb-dock{
  --sidebar:0px!important;
}
/* در داک: زیرمنو تا پورتال‌شدن کاملاً مخفی — وگرنه همه آیتم‌ها داخل داک پخش می‌شوند */
body.sb-dock .dock-flyout{
  display:none!important;
}
body.sb-dock .sb{
  position:fixed!important;
  right:auto!important;left:50%!important;top:auto!important;bottom:14px!important;
  transform:translateX(-50%)!important;
  width:max-content!important;max-width:min(94vw,920px)!important;
  height:auto!important;max-height:88px!important;min-height:0!important;
  flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:10px 14px!important;border-radius:26px;
  overflow:visible!important;contain:none!important;
  z-index:9000!important;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(22,32,48,.94),rgba(10,14,24,.97))!important;
  background-image:none!important; /* عکس پس‌زمینه ستون را روی داک نکش */
  box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.42), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
}
body.sb-dock .sb.has-custom-bg{
  background-image:none!important;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(22,32,48,.94),rgba(10,14,24,.97))!important;
}
body.sb-dock .main{
  margin:0!important;
  width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;
  padding:0 16px 130px!important;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;
  position:relative;z-index:1;
}
body.sb-dock .page,
body.sb-dock .page.active{
  max-width:1080px!important;
  margin-left:auto!important;
  margin-right:auto!important;
  width:100%;
  box-sizing:border-box;
}
body.sb-dock .sb-logo,
body.sb-dock .sb-brand,
body.sb-dock #sb-clock,
body.sb-dock .gs-wrap,
body.sb-dock .sb-foot,
body.sb-dock .nav-badge,
body.sb-dock .sb > .btn{display:none!important;}
body.sb-dock .sb-nav{
  display:flex!important;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  flex-wrap:nowrap;gap:8px;width:auto;max-width:100%;
  overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:visible;padding:6px 2px;
  max-height:none;height:auto;
}
/* فقط آیتم‌های ریشه (مثل داشبورد) + دکمه گروه — نه فرزندان مخفی */
body.sb-dock .sb-nav > .nav-it{
  justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:0;
  padding:6px;margin:0;border:none;border-radius:16px;
  position:relative;overflow:visible;background:transparent!important;
  min-width:52px;flex:0 0 auto;
}
body.sb-dock .sb-nav > .nav-it .nav-txt{
  position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 12px);left:50%;
  transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(6px)!important;
  max-width:0;opacity:0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;
  background:#111827;color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;
  padding:0;border-radius:8px;pointer-events:none;
  transition:max-width .2s ease, opacity .16s ease, transform .2s ease, padding .2s ease;
  z-index:9200;
}
body.sb-dock .sb-nav > .nav-it:hover .nav-txt{
  max-width:180px;opacity:1;padding:6px 10px;
  transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)!important;
}
body.sb-dock .sb-nav > .nav-it .nav-ico{
  width:48px;height:48px;min-width:48px;min-height:48px;border-radius:14px;
  display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  color:#fff!important;
  transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(.34,1.45,.64,1), box-shadow .18s ease;
}
body.sb-dock .sb-nav > .nav-it .nav-ico svg{
  width:22px;height:22px;stroke:#fff!important;fill:none!important;display:block!important;
}
body.sb-dock .sb-nav > .nav-it:hover .nav-ico{
  transform:translateY(-10px) scale(1.1);
  box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35);
}
body.sb-dock .sb-nav > .nav-it.active .nav-ico{
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.35), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35);
}
body.sb-dock .sb-group{
  position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;
  flex:0 0 auto;overflow:visible;width:auto;
}
/* مخفی کردن هر nav-it داخل گروه تا وقتی پورتال باز نشده */
body.sb-dock .sb-group .nav-it{display:none!important;}
body.sb-dock .sb-group > .sb-section{
  display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  width:48px;height:48px;min-width:48px;padding:0;margin:0;
  border-radius:14px;cursor:pointer;position:relative;z-index:2;
  font-size:0!important;line-height:0!important;color:transparent!important;letter-spacing:0;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7dd3fc,#0284c7);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35),0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  text-transform:none;overflow:visible;
  transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(.34,1.45,.64,1), box-shadow .18s ease;
}
body.sb-dock .sb-group > .sb-section:hover{
  transform:translateY(-10px) scale(1.1);
  box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35);
}
body.sb-dock .sb-group > .sb-section .dock-face{
  display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;
}
body.sb-dock .sb-group > .sb-section .dock-face .nav-ico{
  width:48px!important;height:48px!important;min-width:48px!important;min-height:48px!important;
  border-radius:14px!important;box-shadow:none!important;
  display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:transparent!important;
}
body.sb-dock .sb-group > .sb-section .dock-face .nav-ico svg{
  width:22px!important;height:22px!important;stroke:#fff!important;fill:none!important;display:block!important;
}
body.sb-dock .sb-group > .sb-section .sec-ico{
  font-size:22px!important;margin:0!important;width:auto;height:auto;
  box-shadow:none;background:transparent;color:#fff!important;line-height:1!important;
}
body.sb-dock .sb-group > .sb-section .dock-face + .sec-ico,
body.sb-dock .sb-group > .sb-section .chev{display:none!important;}
body.sb-dock .sb-group.dock-open > .sb-section{
  transform:translateY(-12px) scale(1.12);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.4), 0 12px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}
body.sb-dock .sb-group > .sb-section[data-tip]::after{
  content:attr(data-tip);
  position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 12px);left:50%;
  transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(6px);
  background:#111827;color:#fff!important;font-size:11px!important;font-weight:600;
  padding:6px 10px;border-radius:8px;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.3!important;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;max-width:0;overflow:hidden;
  transition:opacity .16s ease, transform .2s ease, max-width .2s ease;
  z-index:9300;
}
body.sb-dock .sb-group > .sb-section:hover::after,
body.sb-dock .sb-group.dock-open > .sb-section::after{
  opacity:1;max-width:220px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
}
/* پورتال زیرمنو روی body */
body.sb-dock .dock-flyout.dock-flyout-portal{
  display:flex!important;
  flex-direction:column;gap:6px;align-items:stretch;
  position:fixed!important;
  min-width:220px;max-width:min(300px,92vw);
  background:rgba(15,23,42,.98);color:#fff;
  border-radius:16px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  z-index:10050!important;
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;
  transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(16px) scale(.96);
  max-height:0;overflow:hidden;padding:0;
  transition:opacity .2s ease, transform .26s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), max-height .28s ease, padding .18s ease, visibility .2s;
}
body.sb-dock .dock-flyout.dock-flyout-portal.dock-flyout-open{
  opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto;
  transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0) scale(1);
  max-height:min(70vh,520px);overflow:auto;padding:10px;
}
body.sb-dock .dock-flyout.dock-flyout-portal::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:100%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  border:8px solid transparent;border-top-color:rgba(15,23,42,.98);
}
body.sb-dock .dock-flyout.dock-flyout-portal .nav-it{
  display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  padding:8px 10px;margin:0;border:none;border-radius:12px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)!important;color:#fff!important;
  white-space:normal;max-width:none;overflow:visible!important;
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)!important;
  transition:opacity .18s ease, transform .22s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), background .15s;
}
body.sb-dock .dock-flyout.dock-flyout-portal.dock-flyout-open .nav-it{
  opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)!important;
}
body.sb-dock .dock-flyout.dock-flyout-portal.dock-flyout-open .nav-it:nth-child(1){transition-delay:.03s}
body.sb-dock .dock-flyout.dock-flyout-portal.dock-flyout-open .nav-it:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.06s}
body.sb-dock .dock-flyout.dock-flyout-portal.dock-flyout-open .nav-it:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.09s}
body.sb-dock .dock-flyout.dock-flyout-portal.dock-flyout-open .nav-it:nth-child(4){transition-delay:.12s}
body.sb-dock .dock-flyout.dock-flyout-portal.dock-flyout-open .nav-it:nth-child(5){transition-delay:.15s}
body.sb-dock .dock-flyout.dock-flyout-portal.dock-flyout-open .nav-it:nth-child(n+6){transition-delay:.18s}
body.sb-dock .dock-flyout.dock-flyout-portal .nav-it:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16)!important;}
body.sb-dock .dock-flyout.dock-flyout-portal .nav-it .nav-txt{
  display:block!important;position:static!important;transform:none!important;
  max-width:none!important;opacity:1!important;padding:0!important;
  background:transparent!important;color:#fff!important;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;
  box-shadow:none!important;overflow:visible!important;white-space:normal!important;
}
body.sb-dock .dock-flyout.dock-flyout-portal .nav-it .nav-ico{
  width:34px;height:34px;min-width:34px;min-height:34px;border-radius:10px;
  display:flex!important;transform:none!important;
}
body.sb-dock .dock-flyout.dock-flyout-portal .nav-it .nav-ico svg{
  width:18px;height:18px;stroke:#fff!important;display:block!important;
}
body.sb-dock.nav-shape-circle .sb-nav > .nav-it .nav-ico,
body.sb-dock.nav-shape-circle .sb-group > .sb-section,
body.sb-dock.nav-shape-circle .dock-face .nav-ico,
body.sb-dock.nav-shape-circle .dock-flyout .nav-ico{border-radius:50%!important;}
body.sb-dock.nav-shape-square .sb-nav > .nav-it .nav-ico,
body.sb-dock.nav-shape-square .sb-group > .sb-section,
body.sb-dock.nav-shape-square .dock-face .nav-ico,
body.sb-dock.nav-shape-square .dock-flyout .nav-ico{border-radius:4px!important;}
body.sb-dock.nav-shape-rect .sb-nav > .nav-it .nav-ico,
body.sb-dock.nav-shape-rect .sb-group > .sb-section{
  border-radius:10px!important;width:56px;height:40px;min-width:56px;
}
body.sb-dock.nav-shape-rounded .sb-nav > .nav-it .nav-ico,
body.sb-dock.nav-shape-rounded .sb-group > .sb-section{border-radius:14px!important;}
body.sb-dock .nav-it[data-tip]:hover::after,
body.sb-dock .nav-it[data-tip]:hover::before{content:none!important;display:none!important;}
body.sb-dock .fab{bottom:110px;z-index:8000;}
@media (max-width:700px){
  body.sb-dock .sb{bottom:8px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:22px;max-width:98vw;max-height:80px!important;}
  body.sb-dock .sb-nav > .nav-it .nav-ico,
  body.sb-dock .sb-group > .sb-section{width:44px;height:44px;min-width:44px;}
  body.sb-dock .page, body.sb-dock .page.active{max-width:100%!important;}
}



/* MAIN */
.main{margin-right:var(--sidebar);min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;}
.topbar{background:var(--card);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:10px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;}
.topbar-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue2);}
.page{display:none;padding:20px;}
.page.active{display:block;}
/* CARDS */
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-card,0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.04));}
.card-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;}
/* GRID */
.g2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}
.g3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}
.g4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}
.g5{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}
/* FORM */
.f{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;}
.f label{font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);font-weight:500;}
.f input,.f select,.f textarea{font-size:12px;padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;background:#FAFAFA;color:var(--text);font-family:var(--font);direction:rtl;width:100%;transition:.15s;}
.f input:focus,.f select:focus,.f textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--blue);background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(24,95,165,.08);}
.f textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:80px;line-height:1.6;}
/* AUTOCOMPLETE */
.acw{position:relative;}
.acl{position:absolute;z-index:999;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:7px;max-height:140px;overflow-y:auto;width:100%;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.1);}
.acl div{padding:6px 10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:var(--text);}
.acl div:hover{background:var(--blue-l);}
/* BUTTONS */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-family:var(--font);background:var(--card);color:var(--text);transition:.15s;white-space:nowrap;}
.btn:hover{background:var(--bg);border-color:#bbb;}
.btn-p{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff;}
.btn-p:hover{background:var(--blue2);}
.btn-g{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff;}
.btn-g:hover{background:#1B5E20;}
.btn-r{border-color:var(--red);color:var(--red);}
.btn-r:hover{background:var(--red-l);}
.btn-o{background:var(--amber);border-color:var(--amber);color:#fff;}
.btn-o:hover{background:#BF360C;}
.btn-pu{background:var(--purple);border-color:var(--purple);color:#fff;}
.btn-sm{padding:4px 9px;font-size:11px;}
.btn-bar{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px;}
/* BADGE */
.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;}
.badge-open{background:var(--amber-l);color:var(--amber);}
.badge-closed{background:var(--green-l);color:var(--green);}
.badge-inv{background:var(--blue-l);color:var(--blue2);border:1px solid #85B7EB;padding:5px 12px;font-size:13px;}
/* SIDEBAR COUNT BADGE */
.nav-it{position:relative;}
.nav-badge{margin-right:auto;background:#fff;color:var(--blue2);border-radius:9px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:1px 6px;min-width:16px;text-align:center;}
.nav-badge.urgent{background:var(--red);color:#fff;}
.sb-section{cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;user-select:none;}
.sb-section .chev{transition:.15s;font-size:9px;}
.sb-section.collapsed .chev{transform:rotate(-90deg);}
.sb-group.collapsed .nav-it{display:none;}
/* DATE PICKER */
.dp-pop{position:fixed;z-index:2000;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.18);padding:12px;width:280px;font-size:12px;}
.dp-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px;}
.dp-head button{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;color:var(--blue2);padding:2px 8px;}
.dp-title{font-weight:700;color:var(--blue2);}
.dp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:3px;text-align:center;}
.dp-grid .dow{color:#999;font-size:10px;padding:3px 0;}
.dp-grid .day{padding:5px 0;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;}
.dp-grid .day:hover{background:var(--blue-l);}
.dp-grid .day.today{border:1px solid var(--blue);}
.dp-grid .day.sel{background:var(--blue2);color:#fff;}
.dp-grid .day.empty{visibility:hidden;}
.dp-foot{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
.dp-time{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;}
.dp-time input{width:38px;text-align:center;padding:3px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;}
/* TASK MODULE */
.task-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.task-tab{padding:8px 18px;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;background:#eef2f7;color:#789;}
.task-tab.active{background:var(--blue2);color:#fff;}
.task-row{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:8px;background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.task-row.overdue{border-color:var(--red);background:#FFF5F5;}
.task-row.done{opacity:.5;}
.task-pr{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;}
.task-pr-urgent{background:#FFE0E0;color:var(--red);}
.task-pr-high{background:var(--amber-l);color:var(--amber);}
.task-pr-normal{background:var(--blue-l);color:var(--blue2);}
.task-pr-low{background:#eee;color:#888;}
.task-grp-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#789;margin:14px 0 6px;}
/* DEVICE CARD */
.dev-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:10px;background:#FAFCFF;}
.dev-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:10px;}
.dev-num{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.dev-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue2);}
.cost-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:8px;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px dashed #ddd;}
.cost-lbl{font-size:11px;text-align:center;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:5px;margin-top:3px;}
.lbl-est{background:var(--amber-l);color:var(--amber);}
.lbl-disc{background:var(--purple-l);color:var(--purple);}
.lbl-fin{background:var(--green-l);color:var(--green);}
/* TOTAL BAR */
.total-bar{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:18px;padding:10px 0 4px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.ti{text-align:center;}
.ti-lbl{font-size:10px;color:var(--text2);}
.ti-val{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;}
/* SAVED TABLE */
.stbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px;}
.stbl th{text-align:right;padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--border);color:var(--text2);font-weight:700;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;background:#FAFAFA;}
.stbl td{padding:7px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #F5F5F5;vertical-align:middle;}
.stbl tr:hover td{background:#F8FBFF;}
.stbl input[type=checkbox]{width:14px;height:14px;cursor:pointer;}
/* PRODUCT */
.prod-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--card);transition:.15s;cursor:pointer;position:relative;}
.prod-card:hover{border-color:var(--blue);background:var(--blue-l);}
.prod-img{width:60px;height:60px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:#f9f9f9;}
.prod-code{font-size:10px;color:var(--text2);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.5px;}
.prod-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue2);margin:2px 0;}
.prod-brand{font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);}
/* PHONEBOOK */
.pb-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:7px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;position:relative;}
.pb-card:hover{background:var(--blue-l);border-color:var(--blue);}
.pb-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue2);}
.ph-tag{background:var(--blue-l);color:var(--blue2);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;}
/* MODAL */
.ov{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);z-index:999;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
#sirman-win-close{position:fixed;top:10px;left:10px;z-index:100000;width:42px;height:42px;border:none;border-radius:10px;background:#c62828;color:#fff;font-size:22px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.25);line-height:1}
#sirman-win-close:hover{background:#b71c1c}
#exit-modal.open{display:flex !important;z-index:2147483000 !important}
body.sirman-app-frame .topbar{padding-left:56px}

.ov.open{display:flex;}
.modal{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:22px;width:92%;max-width:560px;max-height:92vh;overflow-y:auto;position:relative;}
.modal-lg{max-width:760px;}
.modal-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:14px;color:var(--blue2);}
.modal-x{position:absolute;top:14px;left:14px;background:none;border:none;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;color:#999;line-height:1;}

/* ───── مودال برش پس‌زمینه مطابق چارچوب ───── */
#bg-crop-modal .modal{max-width:720px;width:96vw}
#bg-crop-modal .bgc-stage{position:relative;width:100%;height:340px;background:#111;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;touch-action:none;cursor:grab;user-select:none}
#bg-crop-modal .bgc-stage.dragging{cursor:grabbing}
#bg-crop-modal .bgc-stage img{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform-origin:center center;max-width:none;pointer-events:none}
#bg-crop-modal .bgc-frame{position:absolute;border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 9999px rgba(0,0,0,.45);pointer-events:none;border-radius:4px}
#bg-crop-modal .bgc-meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:8px;line-height:1.7}
.viewable-img{cursor:zoom-in}
.prod-img.viewable-img:hover{outline:2px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:1px}
/* ───── مودال نمایش سند/عکس (viewer) با زوم و پرینت ───── */
#doc-viewer{background:rgba(0,0,0,.92);z-index:200000!important;padding:0;}
#doc-viewer.open{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;}
.dv-toolbar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:200001!important;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:10px 16px;background:rgba(20,20,20,.92);}
.dv-toolbar button{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font);transition:.15s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;}
.dv-toolbar button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.25);}
.dv-toolbar .dv-title{color:#fff;font-size:12px;margin-left:auto;max-width:40%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-family:var(--font);}
.dv-toolbar .dv-zoom-val{color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;min-width:50px;text-align:center;}
.dv-img-wrap{flex:1;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:70px 20px 40px;cursor:default;box-sizing:border-box;}
.dv-img-wrap img#dv-img{max-width:min(96vw,1200px);max-height:80vh;width:auto;height:auto;object-fit:contain;transition:transform .15s;box-shadow:0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6);border-radius:4px;transform-origin:center center;cursor:zoom-in;background:#111;}
.dv-hint{position:fixed;bottom:16px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);font-size:11px;z-index:200001!important;font-family:var(--font);background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);padding:6px 14px;border-radius:20px;}
@media print{#doc-viewer,.dv-toolbar,.dv-hint{display:none!important;}body{background:#fff!important;}}
/* ───── کارت ضمیمه سند کلیک‌شدنی ───── */
.doc-thumb{position:relative;display:inline-block;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s;}
.doc-thumb:hover{transform:scale(1.05);}
.doc-thumb img{width:80px;height:80px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #ddd;}
.doc-thumb:hover img{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.15);}
.doc-thumb .doc-del{position:absolute;top:-6px;left:-6px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:50%;width:18px;height:18px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;z-index:2;}
.doc-thumb .doc-del:hover{background:#c0392b;}
.doc-thumb .doc-zoom-badge{position:absolute;bottom:2px;right:2px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);color:#fff;font-size:8px;padding:1px 4px;border-radius:3px;}
/* بخش ضمیمه سند داخل کارت دستگاه گارانتی */
.wdev-docs-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:6px;padding:8px;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:6px;border:1px dashed #cdd;}
.wdev-docs-add{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;color:var(--blue);font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 8px;border:1px dashed var(--blue);border-radius:6px;}
.wdev-docs-add:hover{background:var(--blue-l);}
/* SEARCH BAR */
.search-bar{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px;align-items:center;}
.search-in{flex:1;min-width:160px;padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;font-size:12px;font-family:var(--font);}
/* NOTIF */
.notif-c{position:fixed;bottom:20px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:9999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;align-items:center;pointer-events:none;}
.notif{background:#222;color:#fff;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;pointer-events:auto;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.2);}
.notif.show{opacity:1;}
.notif.err{background:var(--red);}
.notif.ok{background:var(--green);}
/* POSTAL PRINT */
.fab{position:fixed;bottom:22px;left:22px;z-index:500;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:50px;padding:11px 20px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(24,95,165,.4);font-family:var(--font);display:none;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
.fab:hover{background:var(--blue2);}
/* دکمه افزودن دستگاه شناور در صفحه فاکتور — همیشه پایین صفحه قابل دسترس است
   (رفع باگ: قبلاً دکمه در header کارت بود و با اسکرول کردن پایین می‌رفت و قابل‌دسترس نبود)
   z-index بالا (999) برای اطمینان از اینکه هیچ‌چیز روی آن قرار نگیرد.
   display:none به‌صورت پیش‌فرض؛ فقط با showPage('invoice') به inline-flex تبدیل می‌شود. */
.fab-adddev{
  position:fixed!important;bottom:24px!important;left:24px!important;
  z-index:999!important;
  background:var(--green)!important;color:#fff!important;border:none!important;border-radius:50px!important;
  padding:14px 24px!important;font-size:15px!important;font-weight:800!important;cursor:pointer!important;
  box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(46,158,92,.5)!important;font-family:var(--font)!important;
  display:none!important;align-items:center!important;gap:7px!important;
  transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s!important;
  white-space:nowrap!important;
}
.fab-adddev:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)!important;box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(46,158,92,.65)!important;background:#238a52!important;}
.fab-adddev:active{transform:translateY(0)!important;}
.fab-adddev.show{display:inline-flex!important;}
@media print{.fab-adddev{display:none!important;}}
@media print{
  .sb,.topbar,.btn-bar,.modal,.notif-c,button,.no-print{display:none!important;}
  .main{margin-right:0!important;}
  @page{size:A4;margin:8mm;}
  body{font-size:10px;}
}
.postal-wrap{display:flex;gap:10px;font-family:var(--font);direction:rtl;}
.postal-box{flex:1;border:2px solid #333;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.8;}
.postal-logo-box{border:1px solid #aaa;border-radius:4px;padding:4px 8px;text-align:center;float:left;margin-right:10px;margin-bottom:6px;}
.postal-logo-box img{max-width:90px;max-height:36px;object-fit:contain;}
.postal-fragile{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;border:3px solid #333;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 12px;display:inline-block;margin-top:8px;}
/* INVENTORY */
.inv-stat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.stat-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:12px;text-align:center;}
.stat-val{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue);}
.stat-lbl{font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:2px;}
/* PHONEBOOK CATEGORY TABS */
.pb-cat-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px;}
.pb-cat-tab{padding:5px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;white-space:nowrap;}
.pb-cat-tab:hover{background:var(--card);}
.pb-cat-tab.active{background:var(--cat-color,var(--blue));color:#fff;border-color:var(--cat-color,var(--blue));font-weight:700;}
/* IMPORT/EXPORT */
.import-zone{border:2px dashed var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:24px;text-align:center;color:var(--text2);font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;}
.import-zone:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue);}
/* DEBUG PANEL */
.dbg-log{background:#0d1117;color:#e6edf3;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;max-height:320px;overflow-y:auto;direction:ltr;line-height:1.7;}
.dbg-entry{padding:5px 8px;border-radius:4px;margin-bottom:4px;border-right:3px solid transparent;}
.dbg-entry.err{background:#2d1b1b;border-color:#f85149;color:#ffa198;}
.dbg-entry.warn{background:#2b2200;border-color:#d29922;color:#e3b341;}
.dbg-entry.info{background:#0d2137;border-color:#388bfd;color:#79c0ff;}
.dbg-entry.ok{background:#0d2b1a;border-color:#3fb950;color:#56d364;}
.dbg-label{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:2px;opacity:.7;}
.dbg-msg{font-size:12px;direction:rtl;color:#fff;margin-top:2px;}
.dbg-solution{font-size:11px;color:#7ee787;margin-top:4px;padding-top:4px;border-top:1px solid #30363d;}
.dbg-stat-bar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;}
.dbg-stat{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px;text-align:center;}
.dbg-stat .val{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;}
.dbg-stat .lbl{font-size:10px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:2px;}
.dbg-health{height:8px;border-radius:4px;background:#30363d;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:14px;}
.dbg-health-bar{height:100%;border-radius:4px;transition:.4s;}
/* AI CHAT */
.ai-chat-box{background:var(--bg2);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;min-height:260px;max-height:400px;overflow-y:auto;margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
.ai-msg{padding:8px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;max-width:85%;line-height:1.6;}
.ai-msg.user{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;align-self:flex-end;border-bottom-right-radius:2px;}
.ai-msg.bot{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);align-self:flex-start;border-bottom-left-radius:2px;}
.ai-msg.typing{opacity:.6;font-style:italic;}
.ai-model-bar{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px;}
.ai-model-btn{padding:5px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg2);color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;}
.ai-model-btn.active{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-color:var(--blue);}
.ai-input-row{display:flex;gap:6px;}
.ai-input-row input{flex:1;}
/* SETTINGS TABS */
.stg-tabs{display:flex;gap:0;border-bottom:2px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:18px;overflow-x:auto;}
.stg-tab{padding:10px 18px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text2);border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-2px;white-space:nowrap;transition:.15s;}
.stg-tab:hover{color:var(--text);}
.stg-tab.active{color:var(--blue);border-bottom-color:var(--blue);font-weight:600;}
.stg-panel{display:none;}
.stg-panel.active{display:block;}
/* PRINT SETTINGS */
.print-section-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.print-section-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.print-preview-box{background:#fff;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:6px;padding:14px;min-height:120px;color:#333;font-size:11px;direction:rtl;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.print-preview-box.has-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f0f4ff 0%,#e8f0fe 100%);}
.print-bg-select{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px;}
.print-bg-opt{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid transparent;transition:.15s;}
.print-bg-opt.selected{border-color:var(--blue);}
.color-row{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px;}
.color-dot{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid transparent;transition:.15s;}
.color-dot.selected{border-color:var(--text);transform:scale(1.15);}

/* گزارش داخلی شرکت — امضاهای گارانتی */
.company-report{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f0f4ff 0%,#e8f0fe 100%);border:2px solid #2563eb33;border-radius:12px;padding:18px;margin-top:4px;animation:crSlideIn .3s ease;}
@keyframes crSlideIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.cr-report-badge{background:#2563eb;color:#fff;font-size:10px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;}
.cr-sign-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:12px;}
.cr-sign-box{background:#fff;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;}
.cr-sign-box-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#555;margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
.cr-sign-line{border-top:1px dashed #bbb;margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:4px;}
.cr-sign-label{font-size:10px;color:#999;text-align:center;}
@media (max-width:700px){.cr-sign-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

/* ══════ توسعه ظاهر برنامه: تم‌های رنگی، تراکم چیدمان، گردی گوشه، پس‌زمینه ══════ */

/* جلا و افکت‌های نرم روی کارت‌ها و دکمه‌ها */
.card{transition:box-shadow .15s ease;}
.card:hover{box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.07);}
.btn{transition:box-shadow .12s ease, background .12s ease;}
.btn-p:hover,.btn-g:hover,.btn-o:hover,.btn-pu:hover{box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.14);}

/* سواچ تم رنگی */
.theme-swatch{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;border:3px solid transparent;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.15);transition:.15s;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;font-size:14px;}
.theme-swatch:hover{transform:scale(1.08);}
.theme-swatch.selected{border-color:var(--text);transform:scale(1.12);}

/* حالت تاریک */
body.theme-dark{--bg:#15191e;--card:#1e242c;--text:#e6e9ee;--text2:#9aa4b1;--border:#2c333d;}
body.theme-dark .f input,body.theme-dark .f select,body.theme-dark .f textarea{background:#262d36;color:var(--text);border-color:var(--border);}
body.theme-dark .stbl th{background:#1c222a;color:var(--text2);}
body.theme-dark .stbl tr:hover td{background:#222a33;}
body.theme-dark .stbl td{border-color:#2a313a;}
body.theme-dark .modal{background:#1e242c;color:var(--text);}
body.theme-dark .topbar{background:var(--card);border-color:var(--border);}
body.theme-dark .pb-card:hover,body.theme-dark .prod-card:hover{background:#222a33;}
body.theme-dark .import-zone{border-color:var(--border);color:var(--text2);}
body.theme-dark .dev-card{background:#1a2027;border-color:var(--border);}
body.theme-dark .acl{background:#1e242c;border-color:var(--border);}
body.theme-dark .acl div:hover{background:#262d36;}
body.theme-dark .stg-tabs{border-color:var(--border);}

/* اندازه متن */
html{font-size:calc(13px * var(--text-scale, 1));}
body{font-size:1rem;}
/* سازگاری قدیمی sm/lg — اولویت با --text-scale است */
body.text-sm{--text-scale:0.92;}
body.text-lg{--text-scale:1.15;}
.f input,.f select,.f textarea,.btn{font-size:inherit;}
.topbar-title{font-size:1.15rem;}

/* تراکم چیدمان — دلباز */
body.density-spacious .card{padding:24px 26px;margin-bottom:20px;}
body.density-spacious .page{padding:28px;}
body.density-spacious .f input,body.density-spacious .f select,body.density-spacious .f textarea{padding:9px 12px;}
body.density-spacious .btn{padding:9px 16px;}
body.density-spacious .g2,body.density-spacious .g3,body.density-spacious .g4,body.density-spacious .g5{gap:16px;}
body.density-spacious .stbl td,body.density-spacious .stbl th{padding:11px 14px;}
body.density-spacious .f{gap:6px;}

/* تراکم چیدمان — فشرده */
body.density-compact .card{padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:8px;}
body.density-compact .page{padding:12px;}
body.density-compact .f input,body.density-compact .f select,body.density-compact .f textarea{padding:4px 7px;}
body.density-compact .btn{padding:5px 10px;}
body.density-compact .g2,body.density-compact .g3,body.density-compact .g4,body.density-compact .g5{gap:6px;}
body.density-compact .stbl td,body.density-compact .stbl th{padding:4px 7px;}

/* گردی گوشه‌ها */
body.radius-sharp .card,body.radius-sharp .btn,body.radius-sharp .f input,body.radius-sharp .f select,body.radius-sharp .f textarea,body.radius-sharp .modal,body.radius-sharp .dev-card{border-radius:3px!important;}
body.radius-round .card{border-radius:18px!important;}
body.radius-round .btn{border-radius:14px!important;}
body.radius-round .f input,body.radius-round .f select,body.radius-round .f textarea{border-radius:12px!important;}
body.radius-round .modal{border-radius:20px!important;}
body.radius-round .dev-card{border-radius:14px!important;}

/* تصویر پس‌زمینه برنامه */
body.has-bg-image::before{
  content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-2;
  background-image:var(--bg-img);background-size:cover;background-position:center;background-attachment:scroll;
}
body.has-bg-image::after{
  content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,var(--bg-overlay,0.55));
}
body.has-bg-image.theme-dark::after{background:rgba(10,12,15,var(--bg-overlay,0.55));}

/* ══════ اسکین قوی / Skin Pack (v1405.5.21γ) ══════ */
.skin-card{width:148px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:10px;cursor:pointer;background:var(--card);transition:.18s;text-align:right;}
.skin-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(15,40,55,.10);}
.skin-card.selected{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 25%,transparent);}
.skin-card .skin-preview{height:42px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:8px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06);}
.skin-card .skin-preview::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:8px 8px 8px 40%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);border-radius:6px;}
.skin-card .skin-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);}
.skin-card .skin-desc{font-size:10px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.5;margin-top:2px;}
body.has-skin-atmosphere{
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(900px 420px at 8% -8%, color-mix(in srgb,var(--skin-accent,#1AABB8) 14%,transparent), transparent 58%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 92%,#fff) 0%, var(--bg) 100%);
  background-attachment:scroll;
}
body.skin-parsian{--skin-accent:#1AABB8;--skin-sidebar-end:#0A5F73;}
body.skin-ocean{--skin-accent:#14B8A6;--skin-sidebar-end:#0F766E;}
body.skin-graphite{--skin-accent:#64748B;--skin-sidebar-end:#1E293B;}
body.skin-ember{--skin-accent:#EA580C;--skin-sidebar-end:#7C2D12;}
body.skin-windows{--skin-accent:#60CDFF;--skin-sidebar-end:#003E6B;}
/* ویندوز ۱۱ / Fluent-inspired */
body.skin-windows .card{
  border-radius:12px!important;
  border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06)!important;
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.04), 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06)!important;
}
body.skin-windows .btn{border-radius:8px!important;}
body.skin-windows .btn-p{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1B8BFF 0%,#0078D4 100%)!important;
  border:1px solid #006CBD!important;
}
body.skin-windows .topbar{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.72)!important;
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06);
  border-radius:0 0 12px 12px;
}
body.skin-windows .sb{
  background:linear-gradient(185deg,#005A9E 0%,#003E6B 100%)!important;
  border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
}
body.skin-windows .sb-section{
  border-radius:8px;
  margin:2px 6px;
}
body.skin-windows .nav-it{
  border-radius:8px;
  margin:1px 6px;
  max-width:calc(100% - 12px);
}
body.skin-windows .nav-it.active{
  background:rgba(96,205,255,.22)!important;
  border-right-color:#60CDFF!important;
}
body.skin-windows.sb-dock .sb{
  background:rgba(32,32,32,.78)!important;
  backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(140%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(140%);
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  box-shadow:0 -8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
}
body.skin-windows.sb-dock .sb-group > .sb-section{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)!important;
  border-radius:12px!important;
}
body.skin-windows.sb-dock .sb-group.dock-open > .sb-section{
  background:rgba(0,120,212,.85)!important;
}
body.skin-windows.sb-dock .dock-flyout{
  border-radius:12px!important;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)!important;
  background:rgba(32,32,32,.92)!important;
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35)!important;
}
body.skin-windows .modal-box, body.skin-windows .fin-report-card{
  border-radius:12px!important;
}
body.skin-windows .main{
  background:
    radial-gradient(1200px 500px at 10% -10%, rgba(0,120,212,.10), transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(900px 400px at 100% 0%, rgba(96,205,255,.12), transparent 50%),
    var(--bg);
}

body.skin-classic{--skin-accent:#185FA5;--skin-sidebar-end:#0C447C;}
body.has-skin-atmosphere .sb-brand{color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);}
body.has-skin-atmosphere .nav-it.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-right-color:var(--skin-accent,#fff);}
body.has-skin-atmosphere .btn-p{box-shadow:0 4px 14px color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 35%,transparent);}
body.has-skin-atmosphere .sb-logo{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);}

/* ══════ عمق سه‌بعدی سبک (بدون perspective/GPU سنگین) ══════ */
/* عمداً هیچ perspective / translateZ / rotateX / backdrop-filter نیست — همان حس حجمی با سایه */
body.depth-3d{
  --shadow-card:0 1px 2px rgba(10,30,45,.06),0 6px 16px rgba(10,30,45,.08);
  --shadow-card-hover:0 2px 4px rgba(10,30,45,.08),0 10px 22px rgba(10,30,45,.12);
  --shadow-btn:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.2) inset,0 2px 6px color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 28%,transparent);
}
body.depth-3d .card{
  position:relative;
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--border) 75%,#fff);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);
  transition:box-shadow .15s ease;
}
body.depth-3d .card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-card-hover);}
body.depth-3d .topbar{box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(10,30,45,.08);}
body.depth-3d .sb{
  box-shadow:-6px 0 18px rgba(0,0,0,.22), inset 2px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--skin-accent,#1AABB8) 45%,transparent);
  transform:none!important;
}
body.depth-3d .sb-logo{
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  border-radius:0 0 10px 10px;
  margin:0 6px;
}
body.depth-3d .nav-it{
  margin:2px 4px;
  border-radius:8px;
  border-right:none;
  transition:background .12s ease;
}
body.depth-3d .nav-it:hover{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);
}
body.depth-3d .nav-it.active{
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--skin-accent,#1AABB8) 28%,rgba(255,255,255,.12));
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.15);
  border-right:none;
}
body.depth-3d .btn{
  box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55) inset, 0 2px 6px rgba(10,30,45,.08);
}
body.depth-3d .btn:hover{box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.65) inset, 0 3px 10px rgba(10,30,45,.12);}
body.depth-3d .btn:active{box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.15);}
body.depth-3d .btn-p{box-shadow:var(--shadow-btn);}
body.depth-3d .f input,body.depth-3d .f select,body.depth-3d .f textarea{
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgba(10,30,45,.06);
}
body.depth-3d .f input:focus,body.depth-3d .f select:focus,body.depth-3d .f textarea:focus{
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 20%,transparent);
}
body.depth-3d .modal{box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(10,30,45,.22);}
body.depth-3d .dev-card,body.depth-3d .prod-card,body.depth-3d .pb-card,body.depth-3d .stat-card,body.depth-3d .acc-card,body.depth-3d .dash-kpi{
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(10,30,45,.08);
  transition:box-shadow .12s ease;
}
body.depth-3d .dev-card:hover,body.depth-3d .prod-card:hover,body.depth-3d .pb-card:hover{
  box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(10,30,45,.12);
}
body.depth-3d .skin-card{box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(10,30,45,.08);}
body.depth-3d .skin-card:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(10,30,45,.12);}
body.depth-3d.theme-dark .card{box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.28);}
body.depth-3d.theme-dark .f input,body.depth-3d.theme-dark .f select,body.depth-3d.theme-dark .f textarea{
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}

/* Tooltip فارسی */
[data-tip]{position:relative;cursor:help;}
[data-tip]:hover::after{content:attr(data-tip);position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 6px);right:50%;transform:translateX(50%);background:#222;color:#fff;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;z-index:1000;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25);font-weight:400;}
[data-tip]:hover::before{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 2px);right:50%;transform:translateX(50%);border:5px solid transparent;border-top-color:#222;z-index:1000;}
/* راهنمای درختی */
.help-tree{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:10px;}
.help-tree-node{border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.help-tree-node:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.help-tree-label{cursor:pointer;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:800;color:var(--blue2);background:var(--blue-l);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;user-select:none;font-size:13px;}
.help-tree-label:hover{background:#dceaf8;}
.help-tree-node.collapsed .help-tree-children{display:none;}
.help-tree-node.collapsed .help-tree-chev{transform:rotate(-90deg);}
.help-tree-chev{transition:.15s;font-size:10px;}
.help-tree-children{padding:8px 10px 10px;background:var(--card);}
.help-tree-children .help-card{margin-bottom:8px;}
/* امضای چاپ */
.print-sig-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px;margin-top:16px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #ccc;text-align:center;font-size:10px;}
.print-sig-box{min-height:52px;border-top:1px dashed #888;padding-top:6px;margin-top:28px;}
/* صفحه تقویم */
.cal-page-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:4px;text-align:center;margin-top:10px;}
.cal-page-grid .dow{font-size:10px;color:#999;padding:4px;}
.cal-page-grid .day{padding:8px 0;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;}
.cal-page-grid .day:hover{background:var(--blue-l);}
.cal-page-grid .day.today{border:2px solid var(--blue);font-weight:700;}
.cal-page-grid .day.sel{background:var(--blue2);color:#fff;}
.cal-page-grid .day.empty{visibility:hidden;}
.cal-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.war-section-disabled{opacity:.45;pointer-events:none;filter:grayscale(.3);}
.wsoc-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:12px;background:#fafafa;}

/* ───── فروش چندقلمی ───── */
.sale-item-row{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:8px;background:#fafafa;transition:.15s}
.sale-item-row:hover{border-color:var(--blue);background:#f0f7ff}
.sale-item-row .f label{font-size:10px}
.sale-item-row select,.sale-item-row input{font-size:11px;padding:5px 7px}
body.theme-dark .sale-item-row{background:#1a2027;border-color:#2c333d}
body.theme-dark .sale-item-row:hover{background:#1e2833}
/* ───── حسابداری ───── */
.acc-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:10px;background:var(--card);transition:.15s;position:relative}
.acc-card:hover{box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.acc-balance{font-size:20px;font-weight:700}
.acc-balance.positive{color:var(--green)}
.acc-balance.negative{color:var(--red)}
.acc-number{font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);direction:ltr;text-align:right}
.trx-row{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;margin-bottom:5px;background:#fafafa;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:12px}
.trx-row.deposit{border-right:3px solid var(--green)}
.trx-row.withdraw{border-right:3px solid var(--red)}
body.theme-dark .trx-row{background:#1a2027}
body.theme-dark .acc-card{background:var(--card);border-color:var(--border)}
.acc-stat-bar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}

/* ───── Combobox قطعات (قابل تایپ در فرم فروش) ───── */
.part-combo{position:relative;}
.part-combo-input{width:100%;}
.part-combo-list{position:absolute;z-index:998;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--blue);border-radius:7px;max-height:200px;overflow-y:auto;width:100%;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.14);display:none;margin-top:2px}
.part-combo.open .part-combo-list{display:block}
.part-combo-item{padding:7px 10px;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f0f0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px}
.part-combo-item:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.part-combo-item:hover,.part-combo-item.sel{background:var(--blue-l)}
.part-combo-item .pc-name{font-weight:500;flex:1}
.part-combo-item .pc-meta{font-size:10px;color:var(--text2);white-space:nowrap}
.part-combo-item .pc-price{color:var(--green);font-weight:600;font-size:11px}
.part-combo-item .pc-stock-low{color:var(--red)}
.part-combo-empty{padding:12px;text-align:center;color:#aaa;font-size:12px}
body.theme-dark .part-combo-list{background:#1a2027;border-color:#2c333d}
body.theme-dark .part-combo-item{border-bottom-color:#2c333d}
body.theme-dark .part-combo-item:hover,body.theme-dark .part-combo-item.sel{background:#222b34}

/* ───── بج وضعیت پیش‌فاکتور / نهایی ───── */
.badge-proforma{background:#fff3cd;color:#8a6d3b;border:1px solid #ffe08a}
.badge-final{background:#d4edda;color:#155724;border:1px solid #b1dfbb}
body.theme-dark .badge-proforma{background:#3d3419;color:#ffd966;border-color:#5a4a1a}
body.theme-dark .badge-final{background:#1d3a24;color:#81e29a;border-color:#2a5535}

/* ───── کارت تحلیل واریزی‌ها به تفکیک ───── */
.analytics-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:12px;background:var(--card)}
.analytics-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
.analytics-box{padding:10px;border-radius:8px;text-align:center}
.analytics-box.sale{background:var(--blue-l);border:1px solid var(--blue)}
.analytics-box.service{background:var(--green-l);border:1px solid var(--green)}
.analytics-box.manual{background:#f5f5f5;border:1px solid var(--border)}
.analytics-box .ab-val{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px}
.analytics-box .ab-lbl{font-size:10px;color:var(--text2)}
body.theme-dark .analytics-box.manual{background:#1a2027}
.analytics-source{font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);padding:4px 8px;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--border)}
.analytics-source:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.analytics-source .as-tag{display:inline-block;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:8px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;margin-left:6px}
.analytics-source .as-tag.sale{background:var(--blue-l);color:var(--blue2)}
.analytics-source .as-tag.service{background:var(--green-l);color:var(--green)}
.analytics-source .as-tag.manual{background:#eee;color:#666}

/* ───── نوار حذف گروهی (چندانتخابی) ───── */
.bulk-bar{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 10px;background:#fff5f5;border:1px solid #f5b5b5;border-radius:7px;font-size:11px;animation:bulkIn .15s}
.bulk-bar .bulk-cnt{color:#b91c1c;font-weight:700}
.bulk-bar .btn{padding:4px 10px;font-size:11px}
@keyframes bulkIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
body.theme-dark .bulk-bar{background:#2a1515;border-color:#5a2a2a}
/* چک‌باکس سرستون و ردیف در جدول‌ها */
.stbl th input[type="checkbox"],.stbl td input[type="checkbox"]{width:15px;height:15px;cursor:pointer;accent-color:var(--blue);vertical-align:middle}

/* ───── نمایش فولدری/خوشه‌ای برای انبار قطعات ───── */
/* یک کارت بزرگ برای هر دسته (cluster) که شامل چند کالا می‌شود */
.part-cluster{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:14px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--card);transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.part-cluster:hover{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.05)}
.part-cluster-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:11px 14px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue-l),#f0f6ff);border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:background .15s}
.part-cluster.collapsed .part-cluster-head{border-bottom-color:var(--border)}
.part-cluster-head:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#dbeafe,#e8f2ff)}
.part-cluster-icon{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:15px;flex-shrink:0}
.part-cluster-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue2);flex:1}
.part-cluster-meta{display:flex;gap:10px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.part-cluster-badge{padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600}
.part-cluster-badge.cnt{background:var(--blue-l);color:var(--blue2)}
.part-cluster-badge.low{background:#fff3cd;color:#856404}
.part-cluster-badge.stock{background:var(--green-l);color:var(--green)}
.part-cluster-chev{color:var(--text2);transition:transform .2s;font-size:14px}
.part-cluster.collapsed .part-cluster-chev{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.part-cluster-body{padding:8px 10px 12px}
.part-cluster.collapsed .part-cluster-body{display:none}
/* زیرگروه کالا داخل هر دسته */
.part-subgrp{margin:4px 0 8px;border:1px solid #eef2f7;border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden}
.part-subgrp-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 10px;background:#f8fafc;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
.part-subgrp-head:hover{background:#f0f4f8}
.part-subgrp-title{font-weight:600;color:var(--text);flex:1;font-size:11px}
.part-subgrp.collapsed .part-subgrp-body{display:none}
.part-subgrp-body{padding:2px 6px}
.part-subgrp-chev{color:var(--text2);font-size:11px;transition:transform .2s}
.part-subgrp.collapsed .part-subgrp-chev{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
/* ردیف قطعه داخل زیرگروه */
.part-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #f5f5f5;font-size:12px;transition:background .1s;border-radius:5px}
.part-row:hover{background:#f8fbff}
.part-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.part-row input[type="checkbox"]{width:15px;height:15px;cursor:pointer;accent-color:var(--blue);flex-shrink:0}
.part-row .pr-code{color:#aaa;min-width:80px;font-size:10px;font-family:monospace}
.part-row .pr-name{flex:1;font-weight:500}
.part-row .pr-loc{font-size:10px;color:var(--blue2);background:var(--blue-l);padding:1px 6px;border-radius:8px}
.part-row .pr-qty{font-weight:600;font-size:11px;min-width:50px;text-align:center}
.part-row .pr-price{font-size:11px;color:#666;min-width:80px;text-align:left}
/* نوار ابزار نمایش (لیست/فولدر) */
.view-toggle{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden}
.view-toggle button{padding:6px 12px;font-size:11px;border:none;background:var(--card);color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font);transition:.15s}
.view-toggle button.active{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.view-toggle button:hover:not(.active){background:var(--blue-l)}
body.theme-dark .part-subgrp{border-color:#2a3540}
body.theme-dark .part-subgrp-head{background:#1a2027}
body.theme-dark .part-subgrp-head:hover{background:#222a33}
body.theme-dark .part-row:hover{background:#1e262e}
/* فیلتر ماه شمسی */
.jmonth-sel{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}
.jmonth-sel select{padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;font-family:var(--font);background:var(--card);color:var(--text)}

/* ───── منوی کشویی (dropdown) برای گروه‌بندی دکمه‌ها ───── */
.dd{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.dd-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-family:var(--font);background:var(--card);color:var(--text);white-space:nowrap;transition:.15s}
.dd-btn:hover{background:var(--bg);border-color:#bbb}
.dd-btn .dd-chev{font-size:9px;opacity:.6;transition:.15s}
.dd.open .dd-chev{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.dd-menu{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 4px);right:0;min-width:180px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.15);padding:5px;z-index:1000;display:none;animation:ddIn .12s}
.dd.open .dd-menu{display:block}
@keyframes ddIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.dd-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 11px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:var(--text);white-space:nowrap;transition:.1s;border:none;background:none;width:100%;text-align:right;font-family:var(--font)}
.dd-item:hover{background:var(--blue-l)}
.dd-item .dd-ico{font-size:14px;width:18px;text-align:center}
.dd-sep{height:1px;background:var(--border);margin:4px 0}
body.theme-dark .dd-item:hover{background:#222b34}

/* ───── Diff viewer (مقایسه بک‌آپ) ───── */
.diff-chip{display:inline-block;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:9px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;margin:0 3px}
.diff-chip.add{background:#d4edda;color:#155724}
.diff-chip.rem{background:#f8d7da;color:#721c24}
.diff-chip.chg{background:#fff3cd;color:#856404}
.diff-section{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:10px;overflow:hidden}
.diff-section-hdr{padding:8px 12px;background:var(--bg);cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.diff-section-hdr:hover{background:var(--blue-l)}
.diff-section-body{padding:8px 12px}
.diff-section.collapsed .diff-section-body{display:none}
.diff-sub{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;margin:6px 0 3px}
.diff-sub.add{color:var(--green)}
.diff-sub.rem{color:var(--red)}
.diff-sub.chg{color:#8a6d3b}
.diff-list{list-style:none;padding-right:0;margin:0 0 8px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text)}
.diff-list li{padding:2px 8px;border-right:2px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:2px}
.diff-changed-item{padding:6px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:6px}
.diff-tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:10px;margin-top:4px}
.diff-tbl td{border:1px solid #eee;padding:3px 6px}
.sec-chk-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:6px;margin:10px 0;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg)}
.sec-chk-grid label{font-size:11px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;cursor:pointer}
.sec-chk-grid input[type="checkbox"]{accent-color:var(--blue)}

/* restore selective preview */
.restore-inv-meta{font-size:12px;line-height:1.9;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:10px;padding:10px;background:var(--bg2);border-radius:8px}
.restore-inv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:6px;max-height:42vh;overflow:auto;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg);margin:8px 0}
.restore-inv-grid label{font-size:12px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 2px}
.restore-inv-grid .cnt{color:var(--text2);font-size:11px}
.restore-inv-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:10px}
.restore-inv-warn{font-size:12px;color:#b45309;background:#fff7ed;border:1px solid #fdba74;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;margin:8px 0;line-height:1.7}


/* ───── داشبورد مرکزی ───── */
.dash-kpi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(130px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
.dash-kpi{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;text-align:center;transition:.15s}
.dash-kpi:hover{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.dash-kpi-val{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;margin:4px 0}
.dash-kpi-lbl{font-size:11px;color:var(--text2)}
.dash-cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}

.dash-alert{padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:12px;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.dash-alert:hover{background:var(--bg)}
.dash-recent{padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:12px;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.dash-recent:hover{background:var(--bg)}
.dash-tag{display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
body.theme-dark .dash-kpi{background:#1a2027;border-color:#2c333d}

/* ───── جستجوی سراسری ───── */
.gs-wrap{position:relative;padding:6px 10px}
.gs-input{width:100%;padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;font-size:12px;font-family:var(--font);box-sizing:border-box;background:var(--card);color:var(--text)}
.gs-results{position:absolute;top:100%;right:10px;left:10px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--blue);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.15);max-height:380px;overflow-y:auto;z-index:1100;display:none}
.gs-results.open{display:block}
.gs-group-hdr{padding:5px 10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue2);background:var(--blue-l);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.gs-item{padding:7px 10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #f5f5f5;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.gs-item:hover{background:var(--blue-l)}
.gs-item .gs-tag{font-size:9px;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:6px;white-space:nowrap}
.gs-mark{background:#fff3a0;color:#333;padding:0 2px;border-radius:3px;font-weight:700}

.gs-item .gs-tag.inv{background:var(--blue-l);color:var(--blue2)}
.gs-item .gs-tag.sale{background:var(--green-l);color:var(--green)}
.gs-item .gs-tag.war{background:#fff3cd;color:#8a6d3b}
.gs-item .gs-tag.pb{background:#e8eaf6;color:#3f51b5}
.gs-item .gs-tag.task{background:#fce4ec;color:#c62828}
.gs-empty{padding:14px;text-align:center;color:#aaa;font-size:12px}
body.theme-dark .gs-results{background:#1a2027;border-color:#2c333d}
body.theme-dark .gs-item{border-bottom-color:#2c333d}
body.theme-dark .gs-item:hover{background:#222b34}

/* ───── نمای ۳۶۰° مشتری ───── */
.cust360-section{margin-bottom:14px}
.cust360-section-hdr{font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:var(--blue2);margin-bottom:6px;padding-bottom:4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.cust360-info{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:10px}

.cust360-tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:8px}

/* ───── گزارش مالی ───── */
.fin-report-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:12px;background:var(--card)}
.fin-filter-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px}

.fin-summary-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
.fin-summary-box{padding:10px;border-radius:8px;text-align:center}
.fin-summary-box.dep{background:#d4edda;border:1px solid #b1dfbb}
.fin-summary-box.wd{background:#f8d7da;border:1px solid #f5b5b5}
.fin-summary-box.bal{background:var(--blue-l);border:1px solid var(--blue)}
.fin-summary-box .fs-val{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px}
.fin-summary-box .fs-lbl{font-size:10px;color:var(--text2)}
.fin-tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px}
.fin-tbl th{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;padding:5px;text-align:right;font-size:10px}
.fin-tbl td{border:1px solid #ddd;padding:4px 5px;text-align:right}
.fin-tbl tr:hover{background:var(--blue-l)}
.fin-bar-chart{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:flex-end;height:80px;margin:10px 0;padding:6px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:8px}
.fin-bar{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;cursor:default}
.fin-bar-fill{width:100%;min-height:2px;border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;transition:.2s}
.fin-bar-fill.dep{background:var(--green)}
.fin-bar-fill.wd{background:var(--red)}
.fin-bar-lbl{font-size:9px;color:var(--text2);white-space:nowrap}
.fin-bar-val{font-size:9px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text)}
body.theme-dark .fin-summary-box.dep{background:#1d3a24}
body.theme-dark .fin-summary-box.wd{background:#3a1d1d}
body.theme-dark .fin-tbl td{border-color:#2c333d}

/* ───── حواله‌های انبار ───── */
.wh-doc-row{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:12px}
.wh-doc-row:hover{border-color:var(--blue);background:var(--blue-l)}
.wh-badge{display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.wh-badge.in{background:#d4edda;color:#155724}
.wh-badge.out{background:#f8d7da;color:#721c24}
.wh-item-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr;gap:6px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:6px}
.wh-st-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:6px;align-items:center;padding:6px;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f0f0;font-size:12px}

.wh-st-diff.pos{color:var(--green)}
.wh-st-diff.neg{color:var(--red)}

<style id="autosave-dot-css">
/* autosave live indicator */
#autosave-dot{
  position:fixed; bottom:18px; left:18px; width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%;
  background:#16a34a; opacity:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:99999;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(22,163,74,.55);
  transition:opacity .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
}
/* همیشه روشن وقتی ذخیره خودکار فعال است */
#autosave-dot.armed{
  opacity:.85;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(22,163,74,.22);
}
#autosave-dot.on{
  opacity:1;
  animation:autosavePulse 1.4s ease-out;
}
@keyframes autosavePulse{
  0%{ transform:scale(.85); box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(22,163,74,.65); }
  40%{ transform:scale(1.25); box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(22,163,74,.18); }
  100%{ transform:scale(1); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(22,163,74,.22); }
}
body.sb-dock #autosave-dot{ bottom:78px; }
html[dir="rtl"] #autosave-dot{ left:auto; right:18px; }
</style>
